study_type_evidence.quote: A total of 324 SD rats were randomly divided into five groups ... Group one was administered 20 μg/kg BPC157 saline solution intravenously.
the pharmacokinetics, tissue distribution, metabolism, and drug excretion of BPC157 in Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats and beagle dogs as well as in associated in vitro studies

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Sprague-Dawley, ~6 weeks, ~220 g, half male and half female
in_vivo_species.quote: Approximately six-week-old SD rats weighing approximately 220 g were purchased from Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd.
Ten-to-twelve-month-old beagle dogs weighing between 9.8 and 12.8 kg were purchased from YaDong Experimental Animal Research Centre

in_vitro_detail: Associated in vitro studies are mentioned in the introduction but no in vitro half-life is reported in the body.

agents.name: BPC157 (intravenous, rat)
agents.sequence_source: The body does not print the amino-acid sequence; PEPlife2 gives GEPPPPGKPADDAGLV but this could not be confirmed from the text.
agents.group_n_quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters of BPC157 in rats following a single intravenous administration (mean ± SD, n = 6).
agents.dose_route_quote: Group one was administered 20 μg/kg BPC157 saline solution intravenously.
agents.pk_quote: After a single IV administration, BPC157 was rapidly eliminated from the plasma of rats, and the average elimination half-life (t1/2) was 15.2 min.

agents.name: BPC157 (beagle dog)

agents.dose_route_quote: After single IV administration, the t1/2 and AUC0-t of BPC157 in dogs were 5.27 min and 76.4 ± 30.2 ng min/ml.
agents.pk_quote: After single IV administration, the t1/2 and AUC0-t of BPC157 in dogs were 5.27 min and 76.4 ± 30.2 ng min/ml.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: The mean (+SD) plasma concentration of BPC157 versus time curves following administration of various BPC157 doses in rats are shown in Figures 1A-C
concentration_time_figure.note: Separate panels for single IV, single IM dose-ranging, and repeat IM dosing.

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS with solid-phase extraction from 50 μl plasma, dextromethorphan internal standard, ESI on a tandem quadrupole; linear range 4.00-4,000 ng/ml. Total radioactivity by liquid scintillation counting.
bioanalytical_quote: The concentration of BPC157 in the animal plasma at different time points was determined by high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).
notes: All six distinct PEPlife2 half-lives for this PMID were verified against the body: 15.2 min (Table 1, IV), 7.87/17.1/29.7 min (Table 2, IM 20/100/500 μg/kg), 18.5 min (Table 3, repeat IM), and 102 ± 32 h (Table 9). PEPlife2's ten rows are these six values with four duplicated under a second Test Sample spelling ('SD rats plasma' vs 'Rats plasma'). IMPORTANT: the 102 h value is the half-life of TOTAL RADIOACTIVITY after [3H]BPC157, not of the parent peptide - the paper states the prototype drug was undetectable 4 h after dosing and its elimination half-life is under 30 min. Treating 102 h as a BPC157 plasma half-life would overstate it by ~200-fold. The body does not print the amino-acid sequence.
